subject: Retro-audit scope decision: do DONE pilots get a formal pass under the new standard?
payload: Architect has promoted the three-tier methodology to a permanent engineering standard (F1-F7 routed to agent-father). One product decision was NOT made unilaterally: should services with status=DONE or verdict=scale (e.g., kinh-dich TS pilot, technical-analysis Phase 1+2) have a formal retro-audit pass under the new standard? This would verify pilot-status SSOT conforms to schema v2.0, add lessons_baked_in entries, and close any G-goal gaps against the canonical charter. Alternatively, they are grandfathered and only NEW pilots apply the standard from Day 0. Sprint cost: ~1-2 sprints per service for a full retro-audit. Benefit: ensures lessons_baked_in propagation and schema consistency. Please decide and drop a PO decision doc to docs/po-decisions/.

options.label: Grandfathered — DONE pilots keep their current state
options.description: No retro-audit. Only new pilots (Day 0 onward) apply the standard. kinh-dich TS pilot and TA records stay as-is.

options.label: Retro-audit DONE pilots for schema v2.0 conformance only
options.description: Verify pilot-status SSOT schema (field names, no deprecated fields) for each closed pilot. No G-goal re-verification. ~0.5 sprint per service.
options.sprint_cost: ~1 sprint total for all closed pilots

options.label: Full retro-audit DONE pilots: schema + G-goal evidence + lessons_baked_in
options.description: Verify schema v2.0 conformance, capture missing evidence for any YES goals, add lessons_baked_in entries. Highest value but highest cost.

note: F1-F7 (agent-father actions) are independent of this decision. They apply to future pilots only. Do not hold F1-F7 waiting for PO response.
